visualCharacteristics.section: Online Rewards Program / Your Ticket to Savings / Easy Management
visualCharacteristics.purpose: image beside text bands, image on either side per row
visualCharacteristics.description: Each row is a side-by-side band: a picture-only column sized to its image (~400px max, centered) and a text column taking the rest, vertically centered; stacked in authored order below 768px. Lists in the text get blue check-mark bullets; bold links render as red filled buttons, italic links as blue-outline buttons, inline side by side. Option text-first stacks every row text above image on mobile; option image-first (About Us Trusted/Reliable/Proven bands) stacks image above text on mobile and from 768px uses a 3/12 image column that the image fills, with 26px book-weight #333 H3 headings.

contentPattern.structure: one row per band, 2 cells; one cell holds only an image, the other the text (heading, paragraphs, optional bulleted list, optional button paragraphs)
contentPattern.notes: The image cell can be first or last in a row. Button links go one per paragraph: **bold link** = primary (red), *italic link* = secondary (blue outline); consecutive button paragraphs are grouped inline. With image-first, the text cell may hold an H3 and an inline text link inside a paragraph (not a button).

suitableFor: image + text feature bands, alternating sides
promo/membership intro with check-mark benefits list and sign-up / log-in buttons
about/brand value bands: small square image beside an H3 + paragraphs, image always on top on mobile (image-first)
notSuitableFor: three or more text columns (use columns)
card grids or lists of items (use a cards variant)
full-width banners with text over an image (use hero-banner)
